description: Overlay 1 of 6 in the S3 Spine sequence. Maps the load-bearing architecture of any system under Triadic analysis, identifies faultlines (SCS — latent fracture planes), and exposes the interlock geometry between co-active regimes via IPD-12 decomposition. All downstream overlays inherit their coordinate space from the Structural Frame registered here.
role: Registration layer — maps faultlines (SCS), regime interlock geometry, and structural frame; foundational input for all downstream overlays
purpose: Overlay 1/6: maps faultlines (SCS) and regime interlock geometry via IPD-12 decomposition; registers structural frame; primary detector of hidden load-bearing elements and their failure modes
exports: Synthesis gate: structural frame validation flag
